profile.headline: Software Developer | HashiCorp Infrastructure at IBM
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned SRE with 15+ years of experience that enjoys the intricacies of critical production systems. Proactive, pragmatic, team player, with a passion for learning new technologies and applying best practices.

• Linux, HTTP, AWS, GCP, Openstack, Kubernetes, Ansible, Puppet, Prometheus, Docker, ELK (Elasticsearch + Logstash + Kibana), MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Kafka, Spark, InfluxDB, Grafana, Redis, RabbitMQ, Nginx, HAProxy
• HashiCorp tools: Terraform (infrastructure as code), Packer (base OS images), Vault (secrets management), Consul (service discovery), Nomad (cluster scheduler)
• Gitlab, Concourse CI, Jenkins
• Programming: Go, Python, Bash, Git

• Teamwork, leadership, mentorship
• Used to work in Agile delivery environments
• Passion for automating everything, and learning new tools and technologies
• Empathy, humour

positions.title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer II
positions.description:
HashiCorp is a leading software company that enables developers, operators and security professionals to provision, secure, run and connect cloud-computing infrastructure at scale.

• Linux, AWS, HTTP services, HashiCorp products, Concourse CI, containers, Datadog.
• Development: Go, protobuf/gRPC, Temporal.io (used for internal tools and Infrastructure Platform)

• Fully automate and componentize infrastructure to better support the business expansion and scalability, which also facilitated the implementation of an automated Disaster Recovery plan
• Continuously improve our cloud infrastructure's reliability, performance, and cost-effectiveness

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Decided to start a new adventure and created my own company in the UK.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
textPlus is a popular mobile communications service that integrates with US and Canadian telco carriers to offer free/cheap calls, texts and voicemails.

• Linux, Google Cloud, HTTP services, Kubernetes, Go
• Infrastructure automation: Terraform, Packer, Ansible, Gitlab and Docker • Observability: Prometheus + ELK + Grafana + custom on-call platform
• Cassandra, MySQL, Artifactory, Sonar administration

• Extensive Kubernetes usage - redesign and migrate on-premises infrastructure to Google Cloud.
• Rewrite old Java 5/6 monolithic apps in Go microservices, dramatically improving performance, observability, and infra cost optimization
• Revamp slow and over-engineered Jenkins pipelines into reusable and fast Gitlab CI pipelines, and automate a lot of manual processes

positions.title: Lead Platform Engineer
positions.description:
ITV is an international media company (producer and broadcaster), operating the largest commercial family of TV channels in the UK.
During my time here I was leading the Broadcast and Content Management Divisions.

• Linux, AWS, HTTP driven microservices architecture fronted by Nginx/HAProxy, Kong and Varnish • Puppet, Terraform, Jenkins, Docker for infrastructure automation
• Elasticsearch, Influx/Grafana, Sensu, Consul, Slack + Pagerduty for observability

• Work side by side with developers and product owners to deliver highly performant services
• Support and mentor my team, and prioritize workload across product teams
• Infrastructure and services refactor (AWS migrations, containerization, service standardization) for reliability improvement and cost optimization

positions.title: DevOps Team Lead
positions.description:
Tecsisa is a small but well-positioned IT company specialized in cloud-native apps for energy companies. During my time here I led the Infrastructure team.

• Linux, HTTP, AWS/Openstack and Ansible
• Development: Go, Python, Bash and Git
• HashiCorp tools: Terraform, Packer, Consul, Nomad and Vault
• Microservice architecture (12factor apps - most of them Scala, some in Go) using Cassandra, Kafka and Spark clusters
• ELK stack + InfluxDB + Grafana for observability

• Design, implement, operate an automated scalable architecture including CI/CD pipeline, in AWS / on-prem
• Resolve technical issues/challenges by working closely with developers and product owners

positions.title: Release Engineer
positions.description:
Jazztel (now adquired by Orange) is a big telecommunications company in Spain with +3million subscribers.

- Linux, Apache, Nginx, Java/Tomcat/Weblogic: deployments, configurations, pipelines and troubleshooting
- Work closely with devs to debug and troubleshoot app issues
​- DJango Python (HR internal webapp) + PHP (Production Changes internal webapp)
- On-call rotations + scheduled night works

positions.title: Systems/network Operation Technician
positions.description:
IT/Network operator at Jazztel's NOC (24x7)

​- Tier 1 support: Linux, webservers, databases, call-center systems
​- Intranet website development for centralizing information, to make our jobs more efficient (Wordpress + custom PHP development) + others

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
- Web development (Production changes flow - ITIL related)
- Custom scripts for processing CDR files (VO-IP call detail records)

projects.title: Foulkon
projects.description: Authorization server for web resources, written in Go
